title: lane_center: the token champion, camera + radar BEV features -> lane-centre graph
subtitle: Token champion (D113 - D120), VAL 873 frames: topo F1 0.6682 / 0.6813 (seeds 0 / 1), 16.2 ms per frame on an RTX 3060, 2.323 M parameters, no TEST check. Orange / red = the named hard steps; everything else is soft.

select.label: named hard step inside the network: a budget or a gate (gradient through the picked items, not the choice)

rule.label: named hard step on the output only (no gradient)

eval.label: evaluation (numbers and gates, not in the delivered path)

alt.label: measured or kept for comparison, not in the champion

nodes.label:
6 cameras + radar
(nuScenes, one frame,
one radar scan)
nodes.note: 255 scenes, scene-disjoint TRAIN 8,414 / VAL 873 / TEST 833 frames (data/splits.json); one frame and one radar scan per step (D91)

nodes.label:
GaussianCaR BEV
features, frozen,
cached
nodes.note: camera + radar -> 39 channels at 200 x 200 cells of 0.5 m (decoder PCA 32 + 7 map logits), extracted once; the champion starts from the cached features. The code makes them again from raw nuScenes with the foundation's code and weights from outside the repository; a new extraction is close, not bit-identical (net/prep/foundation/README.md)
nodes.why: extracted once with frozen weights (about 0.4 s per frame on the RTX 3060): the 16.2 ms of the chain start from the cached features, so the delivered system from raw sensors is not that fast
nodes.replace_with: an image-radar BEV encoder trained inside the chain, or a small student distilled from GaussianCaR (the direction of the bev_fusion student encoder)
nodes.catch: any replacement has to fit the speed budget (R3); the cache is what keeps the loop cheap; R1 names it as frozen today

nodes.label:
B' pixel stage
pyramid, frozen
(0.5 / 1 / 2 m maps)
nodes.note: one encoder-decoder with three taps: 0.5 m lines, 1 m centres + event heats, 2 m road / intersection; features of the node grid; frozen in both stages
nodes.why: the pixel stage of the lane head B' (E273 stage A, trained before, checkpoint runs/e292_a_s<seed>) is frozen: in stage 2 only its node head trains
nodes.replace_with: train the pyramid with the token loss in stage 2 as well
nodes.catch: measured, no gain: E393 (2026-11-25, VAL, seeds 0 / 1, card in tag v1) trained the pyramid with the token loss from the champion; against the same recipe with the pyramid frozen (B''s node loss off in both) topo F1 changed by +0.0012 / -0.0004, both intervals include 0, so it stays frozen; with the node loss kept it gained +0.0016 on seed 0 (below the 0.010 bar; seed 1 invalid)

nodes.label:
B' node head
one node per 2 m cell
(trained in stage 2)
nodes.note: per cell: existence logit, offset, direction, 8 flag logits, section-start and long-link scores, a 64-d node token; in stage 2 the loss of the token head reaches it (D120), B' keeps its own node loss

nodes.label:
Soft Matrix-NMS
layer on existence
(R 1.75 m, sigma 0.1)
nodes.note: E292: the close-node suppression as a layer of the forward path, no parameters, computed in log space so the gradient is alive; replaces the hard close-node step of the earlier system

nodes.label:
Top-K 512 tokens
by existence
(named budget)
nodes.note: the K = 512 cells with the largest existence logit (a stable argsort) become tokens; cells with sigmoid(e) <= 0.05 are padding
nodes.why: a hard index choice on the existence of B' (the named compute budget of R5): no gradient goes through the choice, the picked tokens carry the gradient to the node head in stage 2
nodes.replace_with: an attention cheap enough for all 2,500 cells of the node grid, or a sparser pair set that keeps the ground-truth links
nodes.catch: K 384 is faster but loses node coverage (E383: GT node coverage 0.9878 against the written 0.99), so K 512 stays; K sets the time of the head

nodes.label:
Live tokens
position, direction,
existence, node token
nodes.note: the delivered path and stage 2: B' runs inside the step, the K tokens are made from its live output with the graph kept (token rounded to float16 as the cache stores it, gradient passed straight through)

nodes.label:
Allowed-pair gate (named hard step)
forward chord, turn <= 130 deg, chord 0.3 - 100 m
nodes.note: also the source of the 13 pair features of the attention bias; the attention bias and the wiring softmax range over the allowed pairs only
nodes.why: a geometric mask on the token pairs of a frame (forward along the chord, turn at most 130 degrees, chord between 0.3 and 100 m); at K = 512 the gate and the token set let 94.3 % of the GT links through (E365 manifest, VAL, B' seed 0)
nodes.replace_with: no mask: the geometry bias alone over all K x K pairs
nodes.catch: costs compute and probably precision; the mask also bounds the wiring softmax; 5.7 % of the GT links lie outside the gate or the token set

nodes.label:
Token embedding
64-d node token +
Fourier pos., heading
nodes.note: x0 = LayerNorm(Linear(tok) + MLP(Fourier(pos), dirv, e, e_raw, flags, s, uout, uin)); 0.127 M parameters in the whole head

nodes.label:
3 x self-attention
relative-geometry bias
+ soft pruning weight
nodes.note: d 64, 4 heads, FFN 128; logit = q.k / 4 + bias(13 pair features) + log(key weight); the key weight is sigmoid(e) of B' for the first 1000 steps, then 1 - p_none of the head itself: no token is dropped inside

nodes.label:
Wiring softmax
per source + none slot
(short <= 8 m / long)
nodes.note: the wiring IS the attention of the last layer: per source and class a softmax over the allowed destinations and one learned none slot; two handle scales per pair give the connector curve

nodes.label:
Node-type softmax
7 classes; p_none is
the pruning weight
nodes.note: none, lane point, fork, merge, junction entry, junction exit, boundary; read after layer 1 and after layer 3 by the same linear layer

nodes.label:
Link read-out (named)
short 0.3, long 0.2,
none gate off
nodes.note: a link is delivered when its probability reaches the threshold of its class (short: chord <= 8 m, long: above) and both ends are kept; three of the four named thresholds
nodes.why: hand-tuned on TRAIN and named (R7, D115): the decode of the champion is link short 0.3, link long 0.2, node keep p_none < 0.6, none gate off
nodes.replace_with: learn the thresholds with a loss that sees the graph metric (delivered lanes, junction precision)
nodes.catch: E388: a soft-F1 surrogate loses (-0.025 / -0.028 topo F1, -0.11 junction F1 on VAL; it loses on TRAIN too), so the thresholds stay named

nodes.label:
Node keep (named)
p_none < 0.6
nodes.note: a token becomes a node of the graph when the none probability of its own type softmax is below 0.6; the fourth named threshold
nodes.why: the same hand-tuned and named read-out (R7, D115); the existence written for a kept node is 1 - p_none shifted by keep_thr - 0.5
nodes.replace_with: a kept-node loss on the graph metric
nodes.catch: as above: the surrogate of E388 lost, and the cell is chosen on TRAIN before the single VAL score (E375)

nodes.label:
Lane graph
nodes, links, types
in the ego frame
nodes.note: the qformat prediction of a frame: nodes (position, direction, existence, flags), links with their Hermite connectors, node types; no GT field
select and tune on TRAIN / VAL only; TEST once per finished design (R12); the champion has no TEST check yet

nodes.label:
Paired scene
bootstrap, band 0.010
topo F1, 2 seeds
nodes.note: scene-level resampling of paired frames; the D115 cell (batch 4, 873 VAL frames)

nodes.label:
Scorer: topo F1,
junction F1, F1@1.0,
lanes found
nodes.note: dump (the head's output per frame) -> a decode of the dump -> the qformat prediction -> the scorer; one definition of every metric, never a private one

nodes.label:
Cost per run: ms,
peak memory,
parameters
nodes.note: every run's predict step times the whole path at batch 1 (CUDA events, cached features), reads the peak GPU memory and counts the parameters; times compare only between quiet runs (GPU and host idle)

nodes.label:
Lane ground truth
v13 / l6
(GtGenerator)
nodes.note: lane GT per keyframe from the nuScenes map: pieces, nodes, links, junction layers; the signature changes with every edit of the generator

nodes.label:
Frames, features,
splits and GT targets
nodes.note: the 39 frozen channels of a frame and the targets drawn from the lane GT (nodes on a 2 m grid, links, pixel maps); rows, normalisation and the stored per-part files come through net/prep/frames.py, which the old chain reads too (p16_data, p8_lib)

nodes.label:
Stage 0: lane head B'
E271 -> E273 -> E292
(off: the stored B')
nodes.note: from random weights, phase by phase with a gate each: the E271 grid head (phase 1), pixel maps, nodes, links, sections, assignment, jointly (E273 phases 2 - 7), then phases 3 4 5 6 9 with the Matrix-NMS layer (E292); the step stage0 with stage0.enabled, else the stored checkpoint runs/e292_a_s<seed> (the B' of the champion)

nodes.label:
Token cache (stage 1)
B' run once, tokens
+ GT labels stored
nodes.note: derived data, not in git: the K = 512 tokens of the frozen B' on every TRAIN and VAL frame with the labels of every token (assignment to the GT nodes, contracted link targets); the loader batches it. The stored cache of runs/e292_a_s<seed>, or (the step tokens, tokens.enabled) the run's own in <run>/tokens

nodes.label:
Stage 1: token head
on the cache
12000 steps
nodes.note: batch 8, lr 1e-3 (5 % warm-up, cosine), AdamW, none weight 0.25; no gradient reaches B' (cached)

nodes.label:
Stage 2 (S4): head +
B' node head together
3000 steps, lr 1e-4
nodes.note: B' runs in the step (live tokens), its node head trains on the token loss plus its own node loss; the champion recipe of D120 (E372), no past block, no map block

nodes.label:
Shared trainer: checkpoint, resume, status.json,
probe; the stages from a run's config
nodes.note: every stage trains and resumes through trainer.fit (the run-directory contract of the research worker; the stop protocol and the probes are trainkit's); lane_train.py starts the stages (stage 0, tokens, stage 1, stage 2) from a run's config

nodes.label: Token loss: per-source likelihood with the none slot + 0.5 type CE + 0.5 L1 of the handle scales
nodes.note: per class and per source the negative log of the summed probability of the GT successors (the none slot when there is none); the none target and class weighted 0.25 in the champion; matching inside the loss only (D55)

nodes.label:
The ends of the junction GT of E284
(measured, not adopted)
nodes.note: the ends of the junction GT (qends) of E284, measured and not adopted; the maneuver count of the read-out (qends.cluster) still reads them; the E284 end head and the rest of the junction thread (E285 - E363) are in the tag v1

nodes.label: B's link, section and assignment stages (E273 C - E): trained in B, not run on the token path
nodes.note: the lane head B is trained with these stages (phases 4 - 6); the token head replaces them; the map side simulates lane-level maps with errors

groups.label: B' = frozen lane head B + soft Matrix-NMS layer (E273, E292): stage 2 trains its node head
token head JTokenHead, 0.127 M parameters (stage 1, then stage 2)
read-out: named hard steps on the output
training: stage 0 (B'), stage 1 (head on the cache), stage 2 (head + node head together)
reference systems and stages that were measured and not adopted (kept, not developed)
